title: Momoi Airi — An Ordinary Moment〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To think that new areas can appear in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Woman C
rows.Line: I've always seen Airi as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Woman C
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm new and don't know what Airi was like when she was still with QT. But based on her behavior, it's clear that she just wants to cheer everybody up and make them smile...

rows.Speaker: Woman C
rows.Line:
That's what I really love about her.
That's why I see her as a pure idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I thought I should just make the most of my experience and talents as a variety-show spectacle...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I see now that I shouldn't typecast myself or narrow down my options like that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't want to disappoint those who see me as a real idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which means I should tell her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry for making you meet with me so early in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: No, that's totally fine since I needed to be here for morning practice!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Anyway, what's up?
There's something you wanted to tell me in person?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It has to do with what we were talking about yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Remember when I said that I wasn't exactly a “pure” idol?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I got the wrong idea about what you were thinking...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Despite you clearly believing that I'm a “pure” idol, I ended up saying something really insensitive...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna make a promise right here to never say anything like that ever again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm going to be the idol that I believe I am moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Yeah! That's what the Airi I know would say!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, why are you getting all teary?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Because I also couldn't get the conversation we had the other day out of my head...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I knew that you're always doing your best as an idol, but I couldn't say anything to help you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's my fault for making you feel that way, so cheer up!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm starting to become an even bigger fan of yours. You can count on me to always cheer you on!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great! And I'll keep doing my best to fill you with tons of hope! As Airi Momoi, the idol!
